discoverySuccessorContract.predecessorOwnershipRule: a move that begins in lookbehind remains owned by the predecessor chunk

residualDiscoveryRisks.mitigation: The model selects an actual bounded final row rather than performing requested-token arithmetic; per-row token counts and the manual disclose the unchanged minimum; deterministic validation rejects reversed or short windows; and a fresh disjoint gate remains mandatory.

costBoundary.estimateBasis: Scaled from the realized v2.1.2 33-context run (14.02 wall minutes, 45.76 aggregate model minutes) and this cohort's 36-context copied-input distribution; subscription use has no direct incremental API charge.
